newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a Fator buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a Fator buy.

text.p: Fator Securities said in a report it was maintaining its buy rating on Brazilian state-owned firm Telebras.
-- also said its year-end target price is 170 reais, "giving a potential upside of 15 percent over the current price.
-- Recent steps towards the privatization of the telecommunications sector contributed to the maintenance of the buy recommendation, according to the Fator report.
-- The report followed Telebras' 1.494 billion reais net profit in the first half of 1997, which was slightly below Fator's forecast of a 1.567 billion reais net profit.
-- said the stock's long-term outlook remains positive but noted volatility was likely in the short run.
-- Telebras preferred was off 2.3 percent at 148.50 reais late afternoon on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa).
